qwen3-30b-a3b-200k._comment: q4_0 KV: at 200k context the q8_0 cache is 9.8 GB -> 30.0 GB total, ~2 GB headroom (fragile after #55). q4_0 -> 25.1 GB total, 7 GB headroom. See docs/llm-agent/tuning.md.

qwen3-30b-a3b-ngram._comment: ngram-mod: speculative decoding with no draft model and no MTP heads; zero extra VRAM. llama.cpp's recommended type for agentic code work. See docs/llm-agent/tuning.md.

qwen3.8-27b-200k._comment: q4_0 KV, not q8_0: at 200k context q8_0 overruns a 32 GB 5090 by ~6.6 GB, so the model can never load. Verified by matrix: 200k/q4_0 and 131k/q8_0 both load, 200k/q8_0 OOMs. See #55.

qwen3.6-35b-a3b._comment: Research candidate #1 (docs/research/balanced-model-replacement.md on research/balanced-model-replacement): 35B total / 3B active hybrid MoE (qwen35moe arch; 10 full-attn layers + 30 DeltaNet -> KV only ~1.0 GB @131k q4_0). UD-Q4_K_XL 22.36 GB weights -> ~25.6 GB total @131k, ~6.4 GB headroom. Vendor thinking-precise-coding preset: temp 0.6, top_p 0.95, top_k 20. SWE-bench Verified 73.4 / Terminal-Bench 2.0 51.5. BEFORE enabling: verify the flake's llama.cpp loads the qwen35moe arch (server log per tuning.md 'Verifying a change').

qwen3.6-35b-a3b-nt._comment: Non-thinking variant of qwen3.6-35b-a3b (enable_thinking=False; budget 0). Vendor non-thinking preset: temp 0.7, top_p 0.80, top_k 20. Test target: the fast, cheap-to-iterate profile that replaces the qwen3-30b-a3b default.

qwen3.6-35b-a3b-cold._comment: Temperature sweep, low end: thinking at temp 0.2 (deterministic band, tuning.md T1) with the vendor top_p 0.95 / top_k 20. Test target: deterministic code edits / structured output with reasoning.

qwen3.6-35b-a3b-hot._comment: Temperature sweep, high end: thinking at temp 1.0 (varied band, tuning.md T1). Test target: robustness where the old A3B default degenerated into infinite loops; per tuning.md T1, raise temperature when a reasoning model loops. Vendor top_p 0.95 / top_k 20 kept.

qwen3.6-35b-a3b-262k._comment: Full native 262k context. Cheap because the hybrid arch's 30 DeltaNet layers carry fixed state: KV @262k q4_0 ~2.0 GB -> ~26.6 GB total, ~5.4 GB headroom (vs 8.6 GB for the 27B dense at 131k). Vendor thinking preset.

qwen3.6-35b-a3b-ngram._comment: ngram-mod: speculative decoding with no draft model and no MTP heads; zero extra VRAM (tuning.md T4). Test target: decode-speed uplift for the thinking profile. Vendor thinking preset.

glm-4.7-flash._comment: Research candidate #2: GLM-4.7-Flash (Z.ai, MIT, 2026-01-19), 30B-A3B deepseek2/MLA MoE, ~3B active. UD-Q4_K_XL 17.52 GB weights -> ~21.5 GB total @131k, 10.5 GB headroom — most of the three candidates; 200k ctx viable. SWE-bench Verified 59.2 / tau2-bench 79.5 / LiveCodeBench v6 64.0. No vendor sampling preset in the research note: temp 0.4 is the repo's reasoning-model convention (qwen3.8-27b) and the tuning.md T1 balanced band.

glm-4.7-flash-hot._comment: Temperature sweep, high end: temp 1.0, balanced top_p 0.95. GLM-4.7-Flash is a reasoning model; per tuning.md T1 raise temperature if it loops or degenerates. No vendor preset in the research note.

glm-4.7-flash-200k._comment: 200k opt-in: MLA KV ~1.8 GB @131k scales to ~2.7 GB @200k q4_0 -> ~24.6 GB total, ~7.4 GB headroom (research note: 'even allows 200k ctx'). Native max pos 202,752. Repo reasoning convention temp 0.4.

devstral-small-2-24b._comment: Research candidate #3: Devstral Small 2 24B (Mistral, 2025-12, Apache-2.0) — 24B dense ministral3 (40 layers, 8 KV heads -> KV 5.4 GB @131k q4_0). UD-Q4_K_XL 14.51 GB weights -> ~22.1 GB total, 9.9 GB headroom; YaRN to 393216 (card 256k). SWE-bench Verified 68.0 — best 24B-class agentic score; dense, so slower per token than the ~3B-active MoEs. Drop-in successor to mistral-small-3.2-24b. Stock llama.cpp needs the mistral3 attn-factor fix (PR #17945, merged 2025-12-12).

devstral-small-2-24b-hot._comment: Temperature sweep, high end: temp 1.0, top_p 0.95. Test target: variance on a dense model — if it loops or degenerates at 0.3, this is the tuning.md T1 lever before changing anything else.
